title: 第99章 红星党魁
content_zh:
落脚处甚是柔软，是一片草地，眼前灯火明亮，人头汹涌。两人都吃了一惊：“料不到这里也有追兵。”听墙外脚步声响，两队巡捕聚在一起，势已不能再跃出墙去，见左首有座假山，假山前花丛遮掩，闵嘉庚负着岳青抢了过去，往假山后一躲。

突然假山后一人长身站起，白光闪动，一柄匕首当胸扎到。

闵嘉庚万料不到这假山后面竟有敌人埋伏，如此悄没声地猛施袭击，仓促间只得摔下背上的岳青，伸左手往敌人肘底一托，右手便即递拳。这人拳脚功夫竟十分了得，回肘斜避，匕首横扎，左手施出擒拿手法，反勾闵嘉庚的手腕，化解了他这一拳。他脸上蒙了一块黄巾，始终默不作声。闵嘉庚心想：“你不出声，那就最妙不过。”耳听巡捕便在墙外，他只须张口呼叫，便即大事不妙。

两个人近身肉搏，各施杀手。闵嘉庚瞧出他的武功是长拳一路，出招既狠且猛，武功造诣竟不在包金朋之下，何况手中多了武器，更占便宜。直拆到第九招，闵嘉庚才欺进他怀中，伸指点了他胸口“鸠尾穴”。那人极为悍勇，穴道遭点，仍飞右足踢来，闵嘉庚又伸指点了他足胫“中渎穴”，这才摔倒在地，动弹不得。

余笙碰了碰闵嘉庚的肩头，向灯光处一指，低声说：“像是在唱戏。”闵嘉庚抬头看去，见空旷处搭了一座戏台，台下一排排坐满了人，灯光辉煌，台上演员尚未出场。维京人有什么喜庆宴会，往往接连唱戏数日，通宵达旦，亦非异事。

闵嘉庚吁了口气，拉下那汉子脸上蒙着的黄巾，隐约见他面目粗豪，四十来岁年纪，低声说：“这汉子想是趁着人家有喜事，抽空子偷鸡摸狗来着，因此一声也不敢出。”余笙悄声说：“只怕不是小贼。”闵嘉庚点了点头，寻思：“瞧这人身手，绝非寻常鼠窃狗盗。也算他活该倒霉，却给我无意擒住。”余笙低声说：“咱们便在这大户人家寻处阁楼躲他个一天一夜。”闵嘉庚说：“我看也只好如此。外边查得这般紧，怎能出去？”

便在此时，戏台上门帘一掀，走出一个人来。那人穿着中山装，走到台口一站，抱拳施礼，朗声说：“同志们、贵宾们、朋友们，请了！”闵嘉庚听他说话声音洪亮，瞧这神情，似乎不是唱戏。又听他说：“此刻天将黎明，转眼又是一日，再过三天，便是武魁大会的会期。可是咱们星派党直到此刻还是没推出党魁来。这件事当真不能再拖。现下请民系的江顺斌**给大伙说说。”

台下人丛中站起一个身穿西服、佩戴红领带的老者咳嗽了几声，上台面向大众说：“锤镰攻防护，为人民服务。咱们星派党三百年来一直分为为、人、民、服、务五个支系，已有三百年没党魁啦。虽说五个支系都好生兴旺，但同志们各存门户之见，人人都说：‘我是为系的，我是人系的……’从不说我是星派党的。没想到别派却从不理会你是为系还是人系，总当咱们是星派党员。咱们人数众多，**们手上传下来的玩艺儿也真不含糊，可是干嘛远远不及别的**帮会名声响亮呢？只因为咱们分成了五个支系，力分则弱，那有什么说的。”

那**顺斌满口阳城话，有几个字闵嘉庚便听不大懂。他说到这里，咳嗽几声，叹了口长气，继续说：“三个月前，咱们在嘉兴接到吴部长派人从维京传来的通知，要咱们星派党在八月中秋赶到维京，参与武魁大会。送信的还特别吩咐了，在大会之中，天下党系、门派、帮会的党魁、龙头、掌门、帮主、掌舵都得露一手本门的高招绝艺，请公家评定高下。这一来，各家各派谁高谁下，从此再不是凭着自个儿信口吹得天花乱坠，而是要凭本事一拳一脚地显示出来。咱们得到通知后，五系**便都聚在一起商议，连为系的毛必成**也带病来到南湖。五系说好，这次要凭真功夫显身手，要在五系中挑一个手脚上玩艺儿最强的，暂且挂一个党魁的名头。”

“不过五支分系已久，各有产业家当，要并在一起是很不容易的。咱们五大**口讲手划，各出绝招，一个多月下来，人、民、服、务四系**都服了毛**功夫第一，可是他老人家五年前中了风，至今手脚动弹不灵，要他到武魁大会中说说拳脚，搞搞思想理论，原是少有人比得上……”他说到这里，台下有人站起身来粗声说：“江**，这武魁大会只怕不是空口说白话就能服人，须真刀真枪，要动个真章的场所。毛**凭他说得天花乱坠，旁人不服那也没用。”

江顺斌接口说：“这位小同志的话很对，很对。于是我们从五系中挑了十名好手，在南湖较量拳脚武器，斗了这一个多月，仍是比不出一个众望所归、技压众人的人来。虽有人胜了，输的人却又不服。现下咱们在这儿光明正大地当众决出胜败，人人都亲眼得见，玩艺儿谁高谁低，大家众目所睹，没人能够偏私。哪位功夫最高的，就算是星派党党魁，到武魁大会中去显显身手。倘若真能为组织挣得个**彩头，大家便当真奉他为党魁。今后各系事务仍由各支系**自行料理，倘若涉及星派党大事，便请党魁决策。他既为组织立下大功，有这个名分也是该的。各位以为如何？”台下众人齐声喝彩，更有许多人噼噼啪啪地鼓掌。

闵嘉庚心想：“原来是星派党在这里聚会。”他张目四望，想要找个隐僻所在，抱着岳青溜出去，但各处通道均在灯火照耀之下，一园中聚着的总有二百来人，只要一出去，定会给人发现，低声说：“只盼他们快些选了党魁出来，越早散场越好。”

只听最先上台那人说：“江**的话句句都是金石良言。我这些年来一直总领人系事务，在这里代表人系的同志们说一句，待会推举了党魁出来，我们人系全心全意听从党魁吩咐。他老人家说什么便是什么，人系决没一句异言！”

台下一人高声叫道：“好！”声音拖得长长的，便如台上的人唱了一句好戏，台下看客叫好一般，其中讥嘲之意，却也甚是明显。

台上那人微微一笑，问道：“其余支系怎么说？”只见台下一个个人站起，说道：“我们为系决不敢违背党魁的话。”“他老人家吩咐什么，我们民系一定照办。”“服系遵从号令，不敢有违。”“务系也没二话。”

台上那人说：“好！各系齐心，那再好也没有了。眼下各系**、代表、同志们都已到齐，只为系毛**没来。他老人家捎了信来，说派他的贤郎毛逃生赴会。但等到此刻还没到。这位同志行事素来神出鬼没，说不定这当儿早已到了，也不知躲在什么地方……”说到这里，台上台下一起笑了起来。

闵嘉庚俯到那汉子耳边，低声问：“你姓毛，是不是？”那汉子点了点头，眼中充满了迷惘之色，实不知这一男二女是甚路道。

台上那人说：“逃生同志一人没到，咱们已足足等了他一天半夜，总也对得住了，日后毛**也不能怪责咱们。现下要请各位**、代表指点党魁是如何选举法。”众人等了一晚，为的便是要瞧这一出选举党魁的好戏，听到这里，全都兴高采烈，台下各人也不依次序，纷纷叫嚷：“凭功夫比试啊！”“谁也不服谁，不凭拳脚器械，那凭什么？”“真刀真枪，打得人人心服，自然是党魁了。”

江顺斌咳嗽一声，朗声说：“本来嘛，党魁凭德不凭力，后生小子玩艺儿再高明，也不能越过德高望重的前辈去。”顿了顿，眼光向众人一扫，又说：“可是这一次情形不同啦。在武魁大会之中，既是英雄聚会，自然要各显神通。咱们星派党倘若选举了个糟老头出去，人家能不能喝一句彩，赞一句：‘好，星派党的糟老头德高望重，够糟够老，老而不死’？”众人听得哈哈大笑。

余笙也禁不住抿住了嘴，心想：“这糟老头倒会说笑话。”

江顺斌大声说：“可是几百年来星派党的四十八路拳脚器械没一个人能说得上路路精通。今日嘛，哪一位玩艺儿最高，哪一位便执掌组织。”众人刚喝一声彩，忽然后门上擂鼓般地敲了起来。

众人一愕，有人说：“是毛逃生到了！”有人便去开门。灯笼照耀，拥进来一队巡捕。

闵嘉庚左手握住了余笙的手，两人相视一笑，危机当前，更加心意相通。

但当相互再望一眼时，余笙却黯然低下了头去，她忽然想到了易点点：“我和大哥一同死在这里，不知点点姐姐会怎样？”她心知闵嘉庚这时也一定想到了易点点：“我和笙笙一同死在这里，不知点点会怎样？”
content_en:
The place where you stand is very soft, it is a piece of grass, with bright lights and crowded people in front of you.Both of them were startled: "I didn't expect there were pursuers here." Hearing the sound of footsteps outside the wall, the two patrol teams gathered together. They could no longer jump out of the wall. They saw a rockery on the left, covered by flowers in front of the rockery. Min Jiageng grabbed Yue Qing and hid behind the rockery.

Suddenly, a man stood up behind the rockery, white light flashed, and a dagger pierced his chest.

Min Jiageng never expected that there would be an enemy ambushing behind the rockery. He attacked so quietly and violently. In a hurry, he had to throw Yue Qing off his back. He stretched out his left hand to touch the bottom of the enemy's elbow, and then punched him with his right hand.This man was very good at boxing and kicking. He turned his elbow to avoid, stabbed horizontally with the dagger, used his left hand to grab Min Jiageng's wrist, and counterattacked Min Jiageng's wrist to neutralize his punch.His face was covered with a yellow scarf and he remained silent.Min Jiageng thought to himself: "It would be best if you don't say anything." Hearing that the patrolman was outside the wall, all he had to do was open his mouth and call out, and something bad would happen.

The two men fought hand to hand, each killing.Min Jiageng saw that his martial arts skills were all the way to Changquan, and his moves were ruthless and fierce. His martial arts skills were not inferior to Bao Jinpeng's, not to mention that he had more weapons in his hands, which gave him an advantage.It wasn't until the ninth move that Min Jiageng stepped into his arms and pointed at the "Dovetail Point" on his chest.The man was extremely brave and even though his acupuncture points were hit, he still kicked him with his right foot. Min Jiageng stretched out his finger and pointed at the "Zhongdu point" on his leg, and then he fell to the ground and could not move.

Yu Sheng touched Min Jiageng's shoulder, pointed toward the light, and whispered, "It looks like we are singing an opera." Min Jiageng looked up and saw a stage set up in an open space, with rows of people sitting under the stage, the lights were brilliant, and the actors on the stage had not yet appeared.It is not unusual for the Vikings to have festive banquets where they would often perform operas for several days and stay up all night.

Min Jiageng breathed a sigh of relief and pulled down the yellow scarf covering the man's face. He vaguely saw that he had a rough face and was in his forties. He said in a low voice: "This man seems to be taking advantage of someone's happy event to take the time to sneak around, so he didn't dare to say a word." Yu Sheng whispered: "I'm afraid he's not a thief." Min Jiageng nodded.He nodded and thought: "Look at this man's skills, he is definitely not an ordinary thief. He deserves to be unlucky, but I accidentally caught him." Yu Sheng whispered: "Let's find a place to hide him in the attic of this wealthy family for a day and a night." Min Jiageng said, "I think this is the only way. The investigation outside is so tight, how can we get out?"

At this moment, the curtain on the stage opened and a person walked out.The man was wearing a Chinese tunic suit, stood at the stage, clasped his fists and saluted, and said loudly: "Comrades, distinguished guests, and friends, please come!" Min Jiageng heard his loud voice, and judging from his expression, it seemed that he was not performing in an opera.I heard him say again: "It is about to dawn, and in the blink of an eye, it is another day, and in three days, it will be the session of the Wukui Conference. But our Star Party has still not elected a party leader until now. This matter really cannot be delayed any longer. Now I ask Jiang Shunbin from the Minzu Party to tell everyone."

An old man in a suit and a red tie stood up from the audience, coughed a few times, came to the stage and said to the public: "We attack protection and serve the people. Our Xingpai Party has been divided into five branches for three hundred years: serving, people, people, serving and serving. There has been no party leader for three hundred years. Although the five branches are prosperous, comrades have their own opinions. Everyone says: 'I am for the branch.Yes, I'm from the human faction...' I never said that I was from the Star faction.I didn't expect that the other factions would never care whether you were a member of the Star faction.We have a large number of people, and the things we handed down are really unambiguous, but why are we far less famous than other gangs?Just because we are divided into five branches, we are weak, so what does it say?

That boy, Shunbin, spoke a lot of Yangcheng dialect, but Min Jiageng couldn't understand a few words.When he said this, he coughed a few times, let out a long sigh, and continued: "Three months ago, we received a notice from Minister Wu in Jiaxing from Viking, asking our Star Party to rush to Viking in the Mid-Autumn Festival in August to participate in the Wukui Conference. The person who sent the letter also gave special instructions. During the conference, the leaders, leaders, heads, gang leaders, and helmsmen of all parties, sects, and gangs all over the world will have to show off their unique skills and ask the public to judge their superiority..In this way, each family's faction will no longer rely on their own words to make the world famous, but will show it with punches and kicks.After we were notified, all the five factions gathered together.After a discussion, Mao Bicheng, the leader of the party, also came to Nanhu sick.The five parties agreed that this time they would show their true skills and choose the one with the strongest hands and feet to take the title of party leader for the time being.

"However, the five branches have been divided for a long time, and each has its own industry and property. It is not easy to merge together. Our five major leaders talked about handcrafts and each came up with unique tricks. After more than a month, the leaders of the four branches of people, people, service, and service have all served Mao Zedong's first kungfu. However, his old man suffered a stroke five years ago and still can't move his hands and feet. He is asked to go to the Wukui ConferenceThere are few people who can talk about fists and kicks, and engage in ideological theory..." When he said this, someone in the audience stood up and said harshly: "Jiang **, this Wu Kui Conference can only convince people with empty words. It must be a real place with real swords and guns.Mao ** can talk so much that it's useless if others don't accept it."

Jiang Shunbin said: "What this young comrade said is very true. So we selected ten masters from the five series and competed with fists, kicks and weapons in Nanhu. After fighting for more than a month, we still couldn't compete with one who was expected to win and outskilled everyone.People come.Although some people win, the losers are not convinced.Now we are here to decide the victory and defeat openly and openly. Everyone can see with their own eyes who is superior and who is inferior.No one can be partial.If a person with the highest skill, even if he is the leader of the Star Party, goes to the Wu Kui Conference to show off his skills, everyone will really regard him as the leader of the party from now on.When it comes to matters involving the Star Party, let the party leader make the decision.Since he has made great contributions to the organization, he deserves this title."What do you think?"Everyone in the audience cheered, and many people applauded.

Min Jiageng thought to himself: "It turns out that the Star Party Party is gathering here." He looked around, trying to find a secluded place, and slipped out with Yue Qing in his arms. However, all the passages were illuminated by lights. There were always about 200 people gathered in the garden. As soon as they went out, people would definitely find them. He whispered: "I just hope they will choose a party leader as soon as possible. The sooner the party ends, the better."

The first person to take the stage said: "Every word of Mr. Jiang's words are good advice. I have been in charge of the affairs of the People's Department over the years. I am here to say something on behalf of the comrades of the People's Department. The party leader will be elected later. We, the People's Department, will wholeheartedly follow the instructions of the party leader. Whatever he says is what he says, and there will never be any objection from the People's Department!"

Someone in the audience shouted loudly: "Okay!" The voice was long and drawn out, as if the person on the stage sang a good joke and the audience in the audience applauded, but the sarcasm in it was also very obvious.

The man on the stage smiled slightly and asked, "What do the other branches say?" A man in the audience stood up and said, "As a branch, we will never dare to disobey the party leader." "Whatever he orders, our people's branch will definitely do it." "The service branch obeys orders and dare not violate it." "The service branch does not hesitate."

The man on the stage said: "Okay! All the departments are united. That couldn't be better. Now all the department leaders, representatives and comrades are here, but Mao Zedong didn't come. His old man sent a letter, saying that he would send his good man Mao Jingsheng to attend the meeting. But it has not arrived yet. This comrade has always been elusive. Maybe he has already arrived at that time, and he doesn't know where he is hiding..." At this point, everyone on the stage and the audience laughed together.

Min Jiageng leaned into the man's ear and asked in a low voice: "Your surname is Mao, isn't it?" The man nodded, his eyes full of confusion, and he really didn't know what the fate of this man and two women was.

The person on the stage said: "Not one of the escaped comrades has arrived. We have been waiting for him for a whole day and a half, so it's okay. Chairman Mao can't blame us in the future. Now I would like to ask all the leaders and representatives to point out how to elect the party leader." Everyone waited all night to see this.It was a good show to elect the party leader. Everyone in the audience was very excited when they heard this. Everyone in the audience was not following the order and shouted: "Let's compete with kung fu!" "If you don't submit to anyone, if you don't rely on fists, feet and weapons, then why?" "With real swords and real guns, if you win everyone's heart, he will be the leader of the party."

Jiang Shunbin coughed and said loudly: "Originally, the party leader relies on virtue rather than strength. No matter how smart a young boy is, he can't surpass his respected seniors." He paused, glanced at the crowd, and said: "But this time the situation is different. After the Wukui Conference,Since it is a gathering of heroes, it is natural for everyone to show off their talents.If our Star Party elects a bad old man, can people applaud and say: 'Okay, the bad old man of the Star Party is highly respected and bad enough to survive old age'?" Everyone laughed when they heard this.

Yu Sheng couldn't help but pursed his lips, thinking: "This bad old man knows how to tell jokes."

Jiang Shunbin said loudly: "But for hundreds of years, no one in the Xingpai Party's forty-eight fists and kicks can be said to be proficient in each of them. Today, whoever has the best skills will be in charge of the organization." As soon as everyone cheered, there was suddenly a drum-like knocking on the back door.

Everyone was stunned, and someone said, "It's Mao Escape!" Someone went to open the door.Lanterns were lit, and a patrol team came in.

Min Jiageng held Yu Sheng's hand with his left hand, and the two looked at each other and smiled. In the face of the crisis, they became even more connected.

But when they looked at each other again, Yu Sheng lowered her head sadly. She suddenly thought of Yi Diandian: "My eldest brother and I died here together. I wonder what will happen to Diandian's sister?" She knew in her heart that Min Jiageng must have thought of Yi Diandian at this time: "Shengsheng and I died here together. I wonder what will happen to Diandian?"
